summary: The fixed-normal support-vector quotient proves that every fiber is a positive translate-homothet of the reference simplex, and convexity together with affine volume radius forces all support gaps to vanish, so the support numbers, scale, translation, and centroid are affine. The mixed-depth bounds then follow with the stated constants from the supplied complete-core, affine half-metronoid matching, canonical product-matching, and metronoid fiber-depth inputs; all threshold cases, positivity conditions, and supremum arguments are handled correctly.
